# Publication-sharing version: 16S-metabolomics integration

This document contains the integrative microbiome-metabolomics workflow extracted from the original notebook. To keep it self-contained for sharing, the setup, package loading, and phyloseq object construction steps are included here before the integration analyses. The downstream sections preserve the original heatmap, network, and DIABLO development history.

# Data loading and phyloseq object construction

```{r load-dada2-and-build-phyloseq}
seqtab <- readRDS("seqtab_nochimera.rds")
taxa <- as.matrix(read.table("taxonomy_table.txt", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "	"))
tree <- read_tree("rooted_tree.nwk")
tree$tip.label <- colnames(seqtab)
rownames(taxa) <- colnames(seqtab)

metadata <- read.table(
  "mapping_file.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  row.names = 1,
  sep = "	",
  comment.char = "",
  check.names = FALSE
)

common_samples <- intersect(rownames(seqtab), rownames(metadata))
seqtab <- seqtab[common_samples, ]
metadata <- metadata[common_samples, ]

metadata <- metadata %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ trimws(as.character(.)))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SampleID")

ps <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(seqtab, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  tax_table(taxa),
  sample_data(metadata),
  phy_tree(tree)
)

# Validation checks
stopifnot(identical(sort(rownames(seqtab)), sort(rownames(metadata))))
stopifnot(identical(sort(colnames(seqtab)), sort(rownames(taxa))))
stopifnot(identical(sort(tree$tip.label), sort(colnames(seqtab))))

sample_sums(ps) %>% summary()
```

# 16S and metabolomics integration 
```{r}

# ============================================================
# STEP 1 — Define the single pre-challenge time point + subset
# Requires: ps already exists
# Output: ps_pre, meta_pre
# ============================================================

library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# --- set your pre-challenge time point label here ---
pre_tp <- "T6"   # change if needed (e.g., "T3")

# Subset to the one time point
ps_pre <- subset_samples(ps, Time_Point == pre_tp)
ps_pre <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_pre) > 0, ps_pre)

# Pull metadata (keep SampleID explicit)
meta_pre <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_pre), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = as.character(SampleID),
    TreatmentGroup = factor(TreatmentGroup),
    Time_Point = as.character(Time_Point)
  )

# Quick checks
cat("Time point kept:", pre_tp, "\n")
cat("N samples at pre-challenge:", nsamples(ps_pre), "\n")
print(table(meta_pre$TreatmentGroup))
stopifnot(all(meta_pre$SampleID %in% sample_names(ps_pre)))
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 2 — Build a Genus-level CLR table for integration # Requires: ps_pre from Step 1 # Output: genus_clr (samples x genera), meta_pre (aligned) # ============================================================
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(microbiome)

# 2A) Agglomerate to Genus
ps_genus <- tax_glom(ps_pre, taxrank = "Genus")
ps_genus <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_genus) > 0, ps_genus)

# 2B) Extract count matrix as samples x genera
genus_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_genus), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_genus)) genus_mat <- t(genus_mat)

# 2C) Clean genus names (use taxonomy to label columns)
genus_tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_genus)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID")

genus_names <- as.character(genus_tax$Genus)
genus_names[is.na(genus_names) | genus_names == "" |
              tolower(genus_names) %in% c("none","unclassified","unknown")] <- "Unclassified"

colnames(genus_mat) <- make.unique(genus_names)

# 2D) Prevalence filter (keeps genera present in >= 15% of mice)
prev <- colMeans(genus_mat > 0)
keep_genera <- names(prev[prev >= 0.15])

genus_mat_f <- genus_mat[, keep_genera, drop = FALSE]

cat("Genus features (before filter):", ncol(genus_mat), "\n")
cat("Genus features (after filter): ", ncol(genus_mat_f), "\n")

# 2E) CLR transform (adds pseudocount internally)
# microbiome::transform expects taxa/features as columns and samples as rows (we have that)
genus_clr <- microbiome::transform(genus_mat_f, "clr")
genus_clr <- as.matrix(genus_clr)

# 2F) Align metadata ordering to the CLR matrix
meta_pre2 <- meta_pre %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% rownames(genus_clr)) %>%
  arrange(match(SampleID, rownames(genus_clr)))

stopifnot(identical(meta_pre2$SampleID, rownames(genus_clr)))

# Save aligned metadata back (optional)
meta_pre <- meta_pre2

# Peek
cat("CLR matrix dim (samples x genera): ", paste(dim(genus_clr), collapse=" x "), "\n")
head(genus_clr[, 1:min(6, ncol(genus_clr))])
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# STEP 3 — Load untargeted metabolomics and align to 16S
# Requires: genus_clr, meta_pre
# Output: metab_mat (samples x features), shared_ids
# ============================================================

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# ---- metabolomics file path (Windows-safe) ----
metab_file <- "D:\\OneDrive - Emory\\Research\\LCMS\\Gacasan_Mouse_Stool_Antipsychotics_JW_12282025\\hilicpos\\Merge\\metabolomics_features_prechallenge.csv"

# Load metabolomics table
metab_raw <- read_csv(metab_file)

cat("Raw metabolomics table dimensions:", dim(metab_raw), "\n")
cat("First few column names:\n")
print(colnames(metab_raw)[1:6])

# Expect: first column = SampleID, remaining columns = numeric features
metab_mat <- metab_raw %>%
  rename(SampleID = 1) %>%
  mutate(SampleID = as.character(SampleID)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SampleID") %>%
  as.matrix()

# -------------------------------
# Sample alignment diagnostics
# -------------------------------
samples_16S <- rownames(genus_clr)
samples_met <- rownames(metab_mat)

missing_in_metab <- setdiff(samples_16S, samples_met)
missing_in_16S   <- setdiff(samples_met, samples_16S)

cat("\nSamples present in 16S but missing in metabolomics:\n")

cat("\nSamples present in metabolomics but missing in 16S:\n")
print(missing_in_16S)

# -------------------------------

# -------------------------------
shared_ids <- intersect(samples_16S, samples_met)

cat("\nSample counts:\n")

# Subset all objects

metab_mat <- metab_mat[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta_pre  <- meta_pre %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% shared_ids) %>%
  arrange(match(SampleID, shared_ids))

# Final alignment check (MUST be TRUE)
stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(genus_clr), rownames(metab_mat)),
  identical(rownames(genus_clr), meta_pre$SampleID)
)

cat("\nFinal aligned dimensions:\n")
cat("  genus_clr:", paste(dim(genus_clr), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("  metab_mat:", paste(dim(metab_mat), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 4 — Preprocess metabolomics matrix for integration # Input: metab_mat (samples x metabolites) # Output: metab_proc (samples x metabolites), plus a QC summary # ============================================================
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ---- 4A) Coerce to numeric safely ----
metab_proc <- metab_mat
mode(metab_proc) <- "numeric"

# ---- 4B) Basic missingness summary ----
na_perc_by_metab <- colMeans(is.na(metab_proc)) * 100
cat("Metabolites with any NA:", sum(na_perc_by_metab > 0), "of", ncol(metab_proc), "\n")

# ---- 4C) Drop metabolites with too much missingness (tunable) ----
max_na_pct <- 20   # keep metabolites with <=20% missing values
keep_cols <- na_perc_by_metab <= max_na_pct
metab_proc <- metab_proc[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

cat("After NA-filter:", dim(metab_proc)[1], "x", dim(metab_proc)[2], "\n")

# ---- 4D) Impute remaining NA with half-minimum per metabolite (common LCMS approach) ----
halfmin_impute <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  mn <- suppressWarnings(min(x[x > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
  if (is.infinite(mn) || is.na(mn)) mn <- suppressWarnings(min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  x[is.na(x)] <- 0.5 * mn
  x
}
metab_proc <- apply(metab_proc, 2, halfmin_impute)
metab_proc <- as.matrix(metab_proc)

# ---- 4E) log transform (stabilizes variance) ----
metab_proc <- log1p(metab_proc)

# ---- 4F) Variance filter (optional but recommended) ----
# keep top X% most variable metabolites to reduce noise for integration
top_var_frac <- 1.00   # set to 0.50 to keep top 50%, etc.
vars <- apply(metab_proc, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
keepN <- ceiling(length(vars) * top_var_frac)
keep_metabs <- names(sort(vars, decreasing = TRUE))[1:keepN]
metab_proc <- metab_proc[, keep_metabs, drop = FALSE]

cat("After variance filter:", dim(metab_proc)[1], "x", dim(metab_proc)[2], "\n")

# ---- 4G) Autoscale (z-score) per metabolite ----
metab_proc <- scale(metab_proc)

# ---- 4H) Final sanity checks ----
stopifnot(identical(rownames(metab_proc), rownames(genus_clr)))
cat("✅ metab_proc ready. Dim:", paste(dim(metab_proc), collapse=" x "), "\n")
```


# ============================================================ # STEP 5A.1 — Genus ↔ metabolite associations (Spearman) # Input: genus_clr (23 x 82), metab_proc (23 x 413) # Output: assoc_raw (long table with rho, p, FDR) # ============================================================
```{r}
library(Hmisc)
library(dplyr)

# Combine matrices for rcorr
X <- cbind(genus_clr, metab_proc)

# Spearman correlations
cors <- rcorr(X, type = "spearman")

# Extract matrices
rmat <- cors$r
pmat <- cors$P

genera     <- colnames(genus_clr)
metabolts <- colnames(metab_proc)

# Subset to genus (rows) x metabolite (cols)
r_gm <- rmat[genera, metabolts, drop = FALSE]
p_gm <- pmat[genera, metabolts, drop = FALSE]

# Convert to long format
assoc_raw <- as.data.frame(as.table(r_gm)) %>%
  rename(
    Genus = Var1,
    Metabolite = Var2,
    rho = Freq
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p = as.vector(p_gm),
    padj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(padj)

# Summary
cat("Total genus–metabolite tests:", nrow(assoc_raw), "\n")
cat("Significant at FDR < 0.05:", sum(assoc_raw$padj < 0.05), "\n")

head(assoc_raw, 10)
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 5A.2 — Treatment-adjusted genus ↔ metabolite associations # Residualize both blocks on TreatmentGroup, then correlate # ============================================================ # ============================================================ # STEP 5A.2 FIX v2 — Feature-wise robust residualization # (handles per-feature collapse to 1 TreatmentGroup after NA/Inf filtering) # ============================================================
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Quick diagnostics (should be 0)
cat("Any NA in genus_clr?  ", any(!is.finite(as.matrix(genus_clr))), "\n")
cat("Any NA in metab_proc? ", any(!is.finite(as.matrix(metab_proc))), "\n")
cat("Any NA in TreatmentGroup? ", any(is.na(meta_pre$TreatmentGroup)), "\n")
cat("TreatmentGroup table:\n")
print(table(meta_pre$TreatmentGroup, useNA = "ifany"))

residualize_mat_safe <- function(mat, meta, rhs = "TreatmentGroup") {
  rhs_all <- droplevels(factor(meta[[rhs]]))
  if (nlevels(rhs_all) < 2) {
    message("⚠️ ", rhs, " has <2 levels overall. Using mean-centering for all features.")
    return(scale(mat, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
  }
  
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(mat), ncol(mat),
                dimnames = list(rownames(mat), colnames(mat)))
  
  n_fallback <- 0L
  
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(mat))) {
    y <- mat[, j]
    ok <- is.finite(y) & !is.na(rhs_all)
    
    rhs_use <- droplevels(rhs_all[ok])
    y_use   <- y[ok]
    
    # If this feature collapses to 1 level after filtering, fallback
    if (length(y_use) < 3 || nlevels(rhs_use) < 2) {
      out[, j] <- y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
      n_fallback <- n_fallback + 1L
      next
    }
    
    df <- data.frame(y = y_use, grp = rhs_use)
    fit <- lm(y ~ grp, data = df)
    
    # Put residuals back in correct rows; untouched rows get mean-centered
    res_full <- y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
    res_full[ok] <- resid(fit)
    out[, j] <- res_full
  }
  
  cat("Residualization fallback (mean-centered) for", n_fallback, "features out of", ncol(mat), "\n")
  out
}

genus_res <- residualize_mat_safe(genus_clr, meta_pre, rhs = "TreatmentGroup")
metab_res <- residualize_mat_safe(metab_proc, meta_pre, rhs = "TreatmentGroup")

cat("✅ Residualized dims:\n")
cat("  genus_res:", paste(dim(genus_res), collapse=" x "), "\n")
cat("  metab_res:", paste(dim(metab_res), collapse=" x "), "\n")
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 5B (robust) — Genus ↔ Metabolite Spearman correlations + FDR # Handles low-N / non-finite / zero-variance pairs safely # ============================================================
```{r}
library(dplyr)

compute_assoc_spearman_safe <- function(X, Y, min_n = 6) {
  stopifnot(nrow(X) == nrow(Y))
  
  Xn <- colnames(X)
  Yn <- colnames(Y)
  
  out <- vector("list", length = length(Xn) * length(Yn))
  k <- 1L
  skipped <- 0L
  
  for (i in seq_along(Xn)) {
    xi_all <- X[, i]
    
    for (j in seq_along(Yn)) {
      yj_all <- Y[, j]
      
      ok <- is.finite(xi_all) & is.finite(yj_all)
      xi <- xi_all[ok]
      yj <- yj_all[ok]
      
      # skip if too few points or either vector has zero variance
      if (sum(ok) < min_n || sd(xi) == 0 || sd(yj) == 0) {
        out[[k]] <- data.frame(
          Genus = Xn[i],
          Metabolite = Yn[j],
          rho = NA_real_,
          p = NA_real_,
          n = sum(ok),
          skipped = TRUE,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        skipped <- skipped + 1L
        k <- k + 1L
        next
      }
      
      ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(xi, yj, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
      out[[k]] <- data.frame(
        Genus = Xn[i],
        Metabolite = Yn[j],
        rho = unname(ct$estimate),
        p = ct$p.value,
        n = sum(ok),
        skipped = FALSE,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      k <- k + 1L
    }
  }
  
  res <- bind_rows(out) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = ifelse(is.na(p), NA_real_, p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
    )
  
  cat("Total pairs:", nrow(res), "\n")
  cat("Skipped pairs (min_n/zero-variance):", skipped, "\n")
  cat("Tested pairs:", sum(!res$skipped), "\n")
  
  res
}

# ---- Run associations safely ----
assoc_adj <- compute_assoc_spearman_safe(genus_res, metab_res, min_n = 6)

# ---- Summaries ----
cat("FDR < 0.05 (tested pairs only):",
    sum(!assoc_adj$skipped & assoc_adj$p_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# ---- Save full edge list ----
write.csv(
  assoc_adj,
  file = file.path(root.dir, "integration_T6_genus_metabolite_spearman_edges_adjusted.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ---- Export top hits (by FDR; exclude skipped/NA) ----
top_edges <- assoc_adj %>%
  filter(!skipped, !is.na(p_adj)) %>%
  arrange(p_adj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 200)

write.csv(
  top_edges,
  file = file.path(root.dir, "integration_T6_top200_edges_adjusted.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ---- "Strong + significant" subset ----
edge_sig <- assoc_adj %>%
  filter(!skipped, !is.na(p_adj), p_adj < 0.05, abs(rho) >= 0.5) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

write.csv(
  edge_sig,
  file = file.path(root.dir, "integration_T6_edges_FDR0p05_absRho0p5.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Saved:\n",
    " - integration_T6_genus_metabolite_spearman_edges_adjusted.csv\n",
    " - integration_T6_top200_edges_adjusted.csv\n",
    " - integration_T6_edges_FDR0p05_absRho0p5.csv\n")
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 6A — Select top associations for visualization # ============================================================
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Use strong + significant edges
heat_edges <- assoc_adj %>%
  filter(
    !skipped,
    !is.na(p_adj),
    p_adj < 0.05,
    abs(rho) >= 0.5
  )

cat("Edges for heatmap:", nrow(heat_edges), "\n")

# Limit size if needed (keeps heatmap readable)
max_edges <- 300
if (nrow(heat_edges) > max_edges) {
  heat_edges <- heat_edges %>%
    arrange(p_adj) %>%
    slice_head(n = max_edges)
}

# Convert to wide matrix (Genus x Metabolite)
heat_mat <- heat_edges %>%
  select(Genus, Metabolite, rho) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Metabolite,
    values_from = rho,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Genus") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("Heatmap matrix dim:",
    paste(dim(heat_mat), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 6A1 — Diagnose edge counts under different thresholds # ============================================================
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Basic counts
cat("Total pairs:", nrow(assoc_adj), "\n")
cat("Skipped pairs:", sum(assoc_adj$skipped), "\n")
cat("Tested pairs:", sum(!assoc_adj$skipped), "\n")

tested <- assoc_adj %>% filter(!skipped, is.finite(rho), !is.na(p_adj))

cat("Tested (finite rho, has p_adj):", nrow(tested), "\n")

# How many significant at different FDR cutoffs?
for (a in c(0.20, 0.10, 0.05)) {
  cat("p_adj <", a, ":", sum(tested$p_adj < a, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
}

# How many "strong" at different rho cutoffs?
for (r in c(0.6, 0.5, 0.4, 0.3, 0.25, 0.2)) {
  cat("|rho| >=", r, ":", sum(abs(tested$rho) >= r, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
}

# Combined grid (quick view)
grid <- expand.grid(
  padj = c(0.20, 0.10, 0.05),
  rho  = c(0.5, 0.4, 0.3, 0.25, 0.2),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

grid$n_edges <- mapply(function(p, r) {
  sum(tested$p_adj < p & abs(tested$rho) >= r, na.rm = TRUE)
}, grid$padj, grid$rho)

grid <- grid %>% arrange(padj, desc(rho))
print(grid)
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 6A — Exploratory heatmap of top genus–metabolite associations # (ranked by effect size; not FDR-significant) # ============================================================
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

# Use tested (non-skipped) pairs only
tested <- assoc_adj %>%
  filter(!skipped, is.finite(rho), !is.na(p_adj))

# Select top edges by absolute rho
topN <- 200   # adjust if you want denser/sparser
heat_edges <- tested %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(rho))) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN)

cat("Using top", nrow(heat_edges), "edges by |rho|\n")
cat("rho range:", range(heat_edges$rho), "\n")

# Pivot to Genus x Metabolite matrix
heat_mat <- heat_edges %>%
  select(Genus, Metabolite, rho) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Metabolite,
    values_from = rho,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Genus") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("Heatmap matrix dim:", paste(dim(heat_mat), collapse = " x "), "\n")
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 6B — Plot exploratory heatmap # ============================================================
```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-1, 0, 1),
  c("#4575b4", "white", "#d73027")
)

# Row-scale for pattern visibility
heat_mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(heat_mat)))
heat_mat_scaled[is.na(heat_mat_scaled)] <- 0

ht <- Heatmap(
  heat_mat_scaled,
  name = "Spearman\nrho",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_title = "Metabolites",
  row_title = "Genera",
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "ρ (exploratory)"
  )
)

draw(ht)

# Save
pdf(file.path(root.dir, "integration_T6_genus_metabolite_heatmap_exploratory.pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 8)
draw(ht)
dev.off()
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 7A — Safe Spearman correlations (genus_res vs metab_res) # Output: assoc_df with Genus, Metabolite, rho, p, padj, n # ============================================================
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

stopifnot(identical(rownames(genus_res), rownames(metab_res)))

X <- as.matrix(genus_res)  # samples x genera
Y <- as.matrix(metab_res)  # samples x metabolites

n <- nrow(X)

# Drop constant columns (sd == 0), which cause NA correlations
x_sd <- apply(X, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
y_sd <- apply(Y, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

X2 <- X[, x_sd > 0, drop = FALSE]
Y2 <- Y[, y_sd > 0, drop = FALSE]

cat("Non-constant genera:", ncol(X2), "of", ncol(X), "\n")
cat("Non-constant metabolites:", ncol(Y2), "of", ncol(Y), "\n")

# Spearman via ranks + Pearson correlation on ranks (fast)
Xr <- apply(X2, 2, rank, ties.method = "average")
Yr <- apply(Y2, 2, rank, ties.method = "average")

rho_mat <- cor(Xr, Yr, method = "pearson")  # genera x metabolites

# p-values (approx) using t statistic
# t = rho * sqrt((n-2)/(1-rho^2))
rho2 <- pmin(pmax(rho_mat, -0.999999), 0.999999)  # avoid division issues
t_mat <- rho2 * sqrt((n - 2) / pmax(1 - rho2^2, 1e-12))
p_mat <- 2 * pt(abs(t_mat), df = n - 2, lower.tail = FALSE)

assoc_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(rho_mat)) %>%
  rename(Genus = Var1, Metabolite = Var2, rho = Freq) %>%
  mutate(
    p = as.vector(p_mat),
    padj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    n = n
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(rho), is.finite(p))

cat("Total tested pairs:", nrow(assoc_df), "\n")
summary(assoc_df$rho)
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 7B — Select top edges (strongest relationships) # ============================================================
```{r}
topN <- 200     # try 100–400; adjust for readability
min_abs_rho <- 0.35  # optional safety threshold

top_edges <- assoc_df %>%
  mutate(abs_rho = abs(rho)) %>%
  filter(abs_rho >= min_abs_rho) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_rho), padj) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN)

cat("Top edges kept:", nrow(top_edges), "\n")
top_edges %>% select(Genus, Metabolite, rho, p, padj) %>% head(10)
```

# ============================================================ # STEP 9B (revised) — Use the FULL set of "top metabolites" # (i.e., the metabolites currently in your heatmap) # ============================================================

{r}
# ============================================================
# STEP 9C (revised) — Filter edges to ALL top metabolites
#   (keep genus unconstrained for now)
# ============================================================

# Expecting your long-format association table:
# assoc_use with columns: Genus, Metabolite, rho, padj (optional)
edges_raw <- assoc_use

# Optional thresholds (start permissive; tighten later if plot too dense)
rho_min  <- 0.25
padj_max <- if("padj" %in% colnames(edges_raw)) 0.20 else Inf

edges_filt <- edges_raw %>%
  filter(Metabolite %in% top_metabolites_full) %>%
  filter(is.finite(rho)) %>%
  filter(abs(rho) >= rho_min) %>%
  { if(is.finite(padj_max) && "padj" %in% colnames(.)) filter(., padj <= padj_max) else . } %>%
  distinct(Genus, Metabolite, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Edges kept:", nrow(edges_filt), "\n")
cat("Metabolites in network:", dplyr::n_distinct(edges_filt$Metabolite), "\n")
cat("Genera in network:", dplyr::n_distinct(edges_filt$Genus), "\n")
# ============================================================ # STEP 9C1 — Diagnose why you got 0 edges # (almost always: thresholds too strict OR assoc_use is empty # OR Metabolite names don't match exactly) # ============================================================
{r}
library(dplyr)

cat("assoc_use rows:", nrow(assoc_use), "\n")
cat("assoc_use cols:", paste(colnames(assoc_use), collapse=", "), "\n")

# sanity check required columns

# Look at rho distribution (to set a sensible cutoff)

# If you have padj, inspect it too

# ============================================================ # STEP 9D1 — Set realistic thresholds for n=23 # Your padj is basically all ~1 (min ~0.206), so a padj filter # will kill everything. For visualization/networking, use rho-only. # We'll keep the strongest correlations by abs(rho) quantile. # ============================================================ library(dplyr)
{r}
# choose a cutoff that actually yields edges
# (90th percentile abs(rho) ~ 0.367; 95th ~ 0.432)
rho_min <- 0.40   # good starting point for a readable network

edges_filt <- assoc_use %>%
  filter(is.finite(rho)) %>%
  filter(abs(rho) >= rho_min)

cat("rho_min:", rho_min, "\n")
cat("Edges kept:", nrow(edges_filt), "\n")
cat("Metabolites in network:", n_distinct(edges_filt$Metabolite), "\n")
cat("Genera in network:", n_distinct(edges_filt$Genus), "\n")

# If still 0, auto-relax to 90th percentile cutoff
if(nrow(edges_filt) == 0) {
  rho_min <- as.numeric(quantile(abs(assoc_use$rho), 0.90, na.rm = TRUE))
  edges_filt <- assoc_use %>%
    filter(is.finite(rho)) %>%
    filter(abs(rho) >= rho_min)

  cat("Auto rho_min (90th pct):", round(rho_min, 3), "\n")
  cat("Edges kept:", nrow(edges_filt), "\n")
  cat("Metabolites in network:", n_distinct(edges_filt$Metabolite), "\n")
  cat("Genera in network:", n_distinct(edges_filt$Genus), "\n")
}
# ============================================================ # STEP 9D2 — Keep "full set of top metabolites" *but* control size # Option A: cap edges to top N by abs(rho) # (This is usually the best way to avoid hairballs.) # ============================================================
{r}
max_edges <- 500  # adjust: 200–800 typically reasonable

edges_top <- edges_filt %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(rho))) %>%
  slice_head(n = max_edges)

cat("Edges after cap:", nrow(edges_top), "\n")
cat("Metabolites:", n_distinct(edges_top$Metabolite), "\n")
cat("Genera:", n_distinct(edges_top$Genus), "\n")
# ============================================================ # STEP 9D3 — Build igraph object + basic plot # Nodes are of two types: Genus vs Metabolite # Edge weight = rho (signed) # ============================================================
{r}
library(igraph)

nodes_met <- tibble(name = unique(edges_top$Metabolite), type = "Metabolite")
nodes_gen <- tibble(name = unique(edges_top$Genus),      type = "Genus")
nodes <- bind_rows(nodes_met, nodes_gen)

edges <- edges_top %>%
  transmute(from = Metabolite,
            to   = Genus,
            weight = rho,
            abs_weight = abs(rho),
            sign = ifelse(rho >= 0, "pos", "neg"))

g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE, vertices = nodes)

cat("Graph summary:\n")
print(g)
cat("Node type counts:\n")
print(table(V(g)$type))
# ============================================================ # STEP 9D4 — Make it readable: prune isolated nodes + layout # (Optional) remove nodes with degree < 2 # ============================================================ # ============================================================ # STEP 9E3D — FIX: g is not a clean igraph (degree() failing) # Rebuild a "plain" igraph from an edge list, then prune by degree # ============================================================ # ============================================================ # STEP 9E3D (patch) — as_data_frame() is masked; use igraph:: # ============================================================
{r}
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)

cat("g class:", paste(class(g), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ---- 1) Get edge list safely (NO masking issues) ----
ed <- igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "edges")   # <- explicit igraph::
# Alternative if you still hit issues:
# ed <- as.data.frame(igraph::as_edgelist(g), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
#   setNames(c("from","to"))

cat("Edge table columns:\n")
print(names(ed))
stopifnot(all(c("from","to") %in% names(ed)))

# ---- 2) Rebuild a clean igraph ----
g_clean <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(ed[, c("from","to")], directed = igraph::is_directed(g))

# ---- 3) Carry over vertex type if present ----
if ("type" %in% igraph::vertex_attr_names(g)) {
  vt <- tibble(name = igraph::V(g)$name, type = as.character(igraph::V(g)$type))
  igraph::V(g_clean)$type <- vt$type[match(igraph::V(g_clean)$name, vt$name)]
}

# ---- 4) Carry over / create weights ----
if ("abs_weight" %in% names(ed)) {
  igraph::E(g_clean)$abs_weight <- as.numeric(unlist(ed$abs_weight))
} else if ("abs_rho" %in% names(ed)) {
  igraph::E(g_clean)$abs_weight <- as.numeric(unlist(ed$abs_rho))
} else if ("rho" %in% names(ed)) {
  igraph::E(g_clean)$abs_weight <- abs(as.numeric(unlist(ed$rho)))
} else {
  igraph::E(g_clean)$abs_weight <- 1
}

w <- as.numeric(unlist(igraph::E(g_clean)$abs_weight))
w[!is.finite(w)] <- NA_real_
if (any(is.na(w))) w[is.na(w)] <- ifelse(all(is.na(w)), 1, median(w, na.rm = TRUE))
igraph::E(g_clean)$abs_weight <- w

# ---- 5) Degree prune (should no longer error) ----
deg_min <- 2
deg_vec <- igraph::degree(g_clean)
g2 <- igraph::delete_vertices(g_clean, igraph::V(g_clean)[deg_vec < deg_min])

cat("After degree prune:\n")
print(g2)
print(table(igraph::V(g2)$type))

# ---- 6) Plot ----
set.seed(1)
lay <- igraph::layout_with_fr(g2, weights = igraph::E(g2)$abs_weight)

w2 <- igraph::E(g2)$abs_weight
wmin <- min(w2); wmax <- max(w2)
edge_w <- if (isTRUE(all.equal(wmin, wmax))) rep(2, length(w2)) else 1 + 4*(w2 - wmin)/(wmax - wmin)

plot(
  g2,
  layout = lay,
  vertex.label.cex = 0.7,
  vertex.size = ifelse(igraph::V(g2)$type == "Genus", 7, 5),
  edge.width = edge_w
)
# ============================================================ # STEP 9E1A — FIX degree-prune error (force igraph + delete by index) # ============================================================
{r}
library(igraph)

cat("Class of g:", paste(class(g), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# If g is a tidygraph tbl_graph, convert to igraph
g_ig <- if (inherits(g, "tbl_graph")) as.igraph(g) else g

stopifnot(inherits(g_ig, "igraph"))

deg_min <- 2

# Always call igraph::degree explicitly
deg_vec <- igraph::degree(g_ig)
cat("degree() class:", paste(class(deg_vec), collapse=", "), "\n")

# vertices to drop (numeric indices)
drop_idx <- which(deg_vec < deg_min)

cat("Vertices to drop:", length(drop_idx), "\n")

# delete safely
g_ig <- igraph::delete_vertices(g_ig, drop_idx)

cat("After degree prune:", igraph::vcount(g_ig), "nodes,", igraph::ecount(g_ig), "edges\n")

# overwrite g so downstream code works
g <- g_ig
# ============================================================ # STEP 9E2 — Choose which nodes get labels (top by degree or strength) # Only label top K genera + top K metabolites by degree # ============================================================
{r}
label_top_each <- 15  # try 10–20

deg_df <- tibble(
  name = V(g)$name,
  type = V(g)$type,
  degree = degree(g)
)

top_gen <- deg_df %>%
  filter(type == "Genus") %>%
  arrange(desc(degree)) %>%
  slice_head(n = label_top_each) %>%
  pull(name)

top_met <- deg_df %>%
  filter(type == "Metabolite") %>%
  arrange(desc(degree)) %>%
  slice_head(n = label_top_each) %>%
  pull(name)

V(g)$label <- ifelse(V(g)$name %in% c(top_gen, top_met), V(g)$name, "")
table(V(g)$type, V(g)$label != "")
# ============================================================ # STEP 9E3 — Clean network plot with ggraph (repelled labels) # ============================================================
{r}
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

tg <- as_tbl_graph(g)

set.seed(1)
p_net <- ggraph(tg, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(aes(width = abs_rho, linetype = sign), alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_node_point(aes(shape = type), size = 2.2, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = label), repel = TRUE, size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 2.5)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_net

{r}
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

tg <- as_tbl_graph(g)

set.seed(1)
p_net <- ggraph(tg, layout = "fr") +

  # ---- Edges ----
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(
      edge_width    = abs_rho,
      edge_colour   = sign,
      edge_linetype = sign
    ),
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +

  # ---- Nodes ----
  geom_node_point(
    aes(
      color = type,
      shape = type
    ),
    size = 2.4,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  # ---- Labels ----
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = label),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +

  # ---- Edge scales (THIS is the key fix) ----
  scale_edge_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "pos" = "#D73027",  # red
      "neg" = "#4575B4"   # blue
    )
  ) +
  scale_edge_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "pos" = "dashed",
      "neg" = "solid"
    )
  ) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 2.5)) +

  # ---- Node scales ----
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Genus"      = "#2E7D32",  # green
      "Metabolite" = "#F57C00"   # orange
    )
  ) +

  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_net

{r}
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

tg <- as_tbl_graph(g)
ig <- as.igraph(tg)

# ---- genera you want to isolate ----
target_genera <- c("Akkermansia", "Lachnospiraceae", "Staphylococcus")

# ---- identify target genera nodes by *name* ----
target_idx <- which(
  V(ig)$type == "Genus" &
  V(ig)$name %in% target_genera
)

cat("Target genus nodes found:", length(target_idx), "\n")

# ---- 1-hop neighborhood: targets + neighbors ----
nbr_idx <- unique(c(
  target_idx,
  unlist(neighborhood(ig, order = 1, nodes = target_idx))
))

# ---- mark nodes to label ----
tg <- tg %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  mutate(label_me = row_number() %in% nbr_idx)

set.seed(1)
p_net <- ggraph(tg, layout = "fr") +

  # ---- Edges ----
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(edge_width = abs_rho, edge_colour = sign, edge_linetype = sign),
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +

  # ---- Nodes ----
  geom_node_point(
    aes(shape = type, color = type),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  # ---- Labels (targets + 1-hop neighbors ONLY) ----
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(label_me, name, "")),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    force = 15,
    force_pull = 1,
    box.padding = 0.8,
    point.padding = 0.6,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  # ---- Edge scales ----
  scale_edge_colour_manual(values = c("pos" = "#D73027", "neg" = "#4575B4")) +
  scale_edge_linetype_manual(values = c("pos" = "dashed", "neg" = "solid")) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 2.5)) +

  # ---- Node scales ----
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Genus" = 16, "Metabolite" = 17)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Genus" = "#2E7D32", "Metabolite" = "#F57C00")) +

  theme_void() +

# ============================================================
# STEP 9E3C — FIX: your genus names have leading spaces
# (trim whitespace before matching)
# ============================================================

library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

tg <- as_tbl_graph(g)
ig <- as.igraph(tg)

# ---- choose genera to label (NO leading spaces here) ----
target_genera <- c("Lachnospiraceae UCG-006", "Akkermansia", "Staphylococcus", "Lactobacillus")

# ---- create trimmed versions of vertex fields for matching ----
vtype <- V(ig)$type
vname_trim <- str_trim(V(ig)$name)
vlabel_trim <- ifelse(is.na(V(ig)$label), "", str_trim(V(ig)$label))

# ---- find target genus vertices (match against trimmed name OR trimmed label) ----
target_idx <- which(
  vtype == "Genus" &
    (vname_trim %in% target_genera | vlabel_trim %in% target_genera)
)

cat("Targets found:", length(target_idx), "\n")
if (length(target_idx) == 0) {
  cat("No targets found. Here are genus names that contain your keywords:\n")
  print(sort(unique(vname_trim[vtype == "Genus" & grepl("Akkermansia|Lactobacillus|Staphylococcus|Lachnospiraceae", vname_trim)])))
  stop("Targets not found — see printed genus names above and update target_genera accordingly.")
}

# ---- neighborhood: targets + 1-hop neighbors ----
nbr_idx <- unique(c(
  target_idx,
  unlist(igraph::neighborhood(ig, order = 1, nodes = target_idx))
))

# ---- mark nodes to label + define display label ----
tg <- tg %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  mutate(
    name_trim  = str_trim(.data$name),
    label_trim = ifelse(is.na(.data$label), "", str_trim(.data$label)),
    disp = ifelse(label_trim != "", label_trim, name_trim),
    label_me = row_number() %in% nbr_idx
  )

cat("Nodes to label (targets + neighbors):", sum(tg %>% activate(nodes) %>% pull(label_me)), "\n")

set.seed(1)
p_net <- ggraph(tg, layout = "fr") +

  # ---- Edges ----
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(edge_width = abs_rho, edge_colour = sign, edge_linetype = sign),
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +

  # ---- Nodes ----
  geom_node_point(
    aes(shape = type, color = type),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  # ---- Labels: ONLY targets + neighbors ----
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, label_me),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = disp),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    force = 25,
    box.padding = 0.9,
    point.padding = 0.7,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  # ---- Edge scales ----
  scale_edge_colour_manual(values = c("pos" = "#D73027", "neg" = "#4575B4")) +
  scale_edge_linetype_manual(values = c("pos" = "dashed", "neg" = "solid")) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 2.5)) +

  # ---- Node scales ----
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Genus" = 16, "Metabolite" = 17)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Genus" = "#2E7D32", "Metabolite" = "#F57C00")) +

  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_net

out_dir <- file.path(knitr_root, "integration_outputs", "network")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save network plot
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "network_plot.png"),
  plot = p_net,
  width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
)

# ============================================================ # STEP 9E3D — Restrict network to selected genera + their 1-hop neighbors # (keeps ONLY those genera and any metabolites directly connected to them) # ============================================================
{r}
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

tg0 <- as_tbl_graph(g)
ig0 <- as.igraph(tg0)

# ---- genera to keep (use EXACT names you saw, incl. bracketed Eubacterium groups) ----
target_genera <- c(
  "Akkermansia",
  "Lactobacillus",
  "Turicibacter",
  "Butyricicoccus",
  "Staphylococcus",
  "Clostridium sensu stricto 1",
  "Romboutsia",
  " [Eubacterium] xylanophilum group",
  " [Eubacterium] oxidoreducens group"
)

# ---- trim helper vectors for matching ----
vtype       <- V(ig0)$type
vname_trim  <- str_trim(V(ig0)$name)
vlabel_trim <- ifelse(is.na(V(ig0)$label), "", str_trim(V(ig0)$label))

target_idx <- which(
  vtype == "Genus" &
    (vname_trim %in% target_genera | vlabel_trim %in% target_genera)
)

cat("Targets found:", length(target_idx), "\n")
if (length(target_idx) == 0) {
  cat("No targets found. Available genus names matching keywords:\n")
  print(sort(unique(vname_trim[vtype == "Genus" & grepl("Akkermansia|Lactobacillus|Turicibacter|Butyricicoccus|Staphylococcus|Clostridium|Eubacterium|Romboutsia", vname_trim)])))
  stop("Targets not found — copy/paste exact genus names from the list above into target_genera.")
}

# ---- neighborhood: targets + 1-hop neighbors ----
nbr_idx <- unique(c(
  target_idx,
  unlist(igraph::neighborhood(ig0, order = 1, nodes = target_idx))
))

# ---- Induce subgraph containing ONLY targets + their neighbors ----
ig_sub <- igraph::induced_subgraph(ig0, vids = nbr_idx)

# convert back to tbl_graph for ggraph
tg <- tidygraph::as_tbl_graph(ig_sub)

# ---- label only the target genera + their 1-hop neighbors (same as whole subgraph) ----
tg <- tg %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  mutate(
    name_trim  = str_trim(.data$name),
    label_trim = ifelse(is.na(.data$label), "", str_trim(.data$label)),
    disp = ifelse(label_trim != "", label_trim, name_trim),
    is_target = (.data$type == "Genus") & (name_trim %in% target_genera | label_trim %in% target_genera),
    label_me  = TRUE  # label everything in this restricted view (change to is_target if you only want genera labeled)
  )

cat("Nodes in restricted network:", tg %>% activate(nodes) %>% nrow(), "\n")
cat("Edges in restricted network:", tg %>% activate(edges) %>% nrow(), "\n")

set.seed(1)
p_net <- ggraph(tg, layout = "fr") +

  # ---- Edges ----
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(edge_width = abs_rho, edge_colour = sign, edge_linetype = sign),
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +

  # ---- Nodes (bigger) ----
  geom_node_point(
    aes(shape = type, color = type),
    size = 3.8,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  # ---- Labels (bigger) ----
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, label_me),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = disp),
    size = 4.8,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    force = 25,
    box.padding = 1.1,
    point.padding = 0.9,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  # ---- Edge scales ----
  scale_edge_colour_manual(values = c("pos" = "#D73027", "neg" = "#4575B4")) +
  scale_edge_linetype_manual(values = c("pos" = "dashed", "neg" = "solid")) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 2.5)) +

  # ---- Node scales ----
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Genus" = 16, "Metabolite" = 17)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Genus" = "#2E7D32", "Metabolite" = "#F57C00")) +

  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_net

# ---- Save outputs to knitr root ----
knitr_root <- knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir")
if (is.null(knitr_root) || is.na(knitr_root) || knitr_root == "") knitr_root <- getwd()

out_dir <- file.path(knitr_root, "integration_outputs", "network")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "network_plot_restricted_selected_genera_1hop.png"),
  plot = p_net,
  width = 14,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)

# ---- Optional: also save the restricted nodes/edges tables ----
nodes_df <- tg %>% activate(nodes) %>% as_tibble()
edges_df <- tg %>% activate(edges) %>% as_tibble()

write.csv(nodes_df, file.path(out_dir, "network_nodes_restricted_selected_genera_1hop.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(edges_df, file.path(out_dir, "network_edges_restricted_selected_genera_1hop.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    disp = ifelse(label_trim != "", label_trim, name_trim),
    label_me = row_number() %in% nbr_idx
  )

cat("Nodes to label (targets + neighbors):", sum(tg %>% activate(nodes) %>% pull(label_me)), "\n")

set.seed(1)
p_net <- ggraph(tg, layout = "fr") +

  # ---- Edges ----
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(edge_width = abs_rho, edge_colour = sign, edge_linetype = sign),
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +

    # ---- Nodes (bigger) ----
  geom_node_point(
    aes(shape = type, color = type),
    size = 3.8,        # ⬅️ was 2.2
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  # ---- Labels (bigger) ----
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = function(x) dplyr::filter(x, label_me),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = disp),
    size = 4.8,        # ⬅️ was 3
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    force = 25,
    box.padding = 1.1,
    point.padding = 0.9,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  # ---- Edge scales ----
  scale_edge_colour_manual(values = c("pos" = "#D73027", "neg" = "#4575B4")) +
  scale_edge_linetype_manual(values = c("pos" = "dashed", "neg" = "solid")) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 2.5)) +

  # ---- Node scales ----
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Genus" = 16, "Metabolite" = 17)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Genus" = "#2E7D32", "Metabolite" = "#F57C00")) +

  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_net

out_dir <- file.path(knitr_root, "integration_outputs", "network")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save network plot
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "network_plot_test_5genera.png"),
  plot = p_net,
  width = 18,    # ⬅️ was 12
  height = 10,   # ⬅️ was 8
  dpi = 300
)
```




# ============================================================
# STEP 2 — Build a Genus-level CLR table for integration
# Requires: ps_pre from Step 1
# Output: genus_clr (samples x genera), meta_pre (aligned)
# ============================================================

```{r}

library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(microbiome)

# 2A) Agglomerate to Genus
ps_genus <- tax_glom(ps_pre, taxrank = "Genus")
ps_genus <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_genus) > 0, ps_genus)

# 2B) Extract count matrix as samples x genera
genus_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_genus), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_genus)) genus_mat <- t(genus_mat)

# 2C) Clean genus names (use taxonomy to label columns)
genus_tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_genus)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID")

genus_names <- as.character(genus_tax$Genus)
genus_names[is.na(genus_names) | genus_names == "" |
              tolower(genus_names) %in% c("none","unclassified","unknown")] <- "Unclassified"

colnames(genus_mat) <- make.unique(genus_names)

# 2D) Prevalence filter (keeps genera present in >= 15% of mice)
prev <- colMeans(genus_mat > 0)
keep_genera <- names(prev[prev >= 0.15])

genus_mat_f <- genus_mat[, keep_genera, drop = FALSE]

cat("Genus features (before filter):", ncol(genus_mat), "\n")
cat("Genus features (after filter): ", ncol(genus_mat_f), "\n")

# 2E) CLR transform (adds pseudocount internally)
# microbiome::transform expects taxa/features as columns and samples as rows (we have that)
genus_clr <- microbiome::transform(genus_mat_f, "clr")
genus_clr <- as.matrix(genus_clr)

# 2F) Align metadata ordering to the CLR matrix
meta_pre2 <- meta_pre %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% rownames(genus_clr)) %>%
  arrange(match(SampleID, rownames(genus_clr)))

stopifnot(identical(meta_pre2$SampleID, rownames(genus_clr)))

# Save aligned metadata back (optional)
meta_pre <- meta_pre2

# Peek
cat("CLR matrix dim (samples x genera): ", paste(dim(genus_clr), collapse=" x "), "\n")
head(genus_clr[, 1:min(6, ncol(genus_clr))])
```



# ============================================================
# STEP 3 — Load untargeted metabolomics and align to 16S
# Requires: genus_clr, meta_pre
# Output: metab_mat (samples x features), shared_ids
# ============================================================

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# ---- metabolomics file path (Windows-safe) ----
metab_file <- "D:/OneDrive - Emory/Research/LCMS/Gacasan_Mouse_Stool_Antipsychotics_JW_12282025/hilicpos/Merge/Annotated_Metaboanalyst_Post.csv"

# Load metabolomics table
metab_raw <- read_csv(metab_file)

cat("Raw metabolomics table dimensions:", dim(metab_raw), "\n")
cat("First few column names:\n")
print(colnames(metab_raw)[1:6])

# Expect: first column = SampleID, remaining columns = numeric features
metab_mat <- metab_raw %>%
  rename(SampleID = 1) %>%
  mutate(SampleID = as.character(SampleID)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("SampleID") %>%
  as.matrix()

# -------------------------------
# Sample alignment diagnostics
# -------------------------------
samples_16S <- rownames(genus_clr)
samples_met <- rownames(metab_mat)

missing_in_metab <- setdiff(samples_16S, samples_met)
missing_in_16S   <- setdiff(samples_met, samples_16S)

cat("\nSamples present in 16S but missing in metabolomics:\n")
print(missing_in_metab)

cat("\nSamples present in metabolomics but missing in 16S:\n")
print(missing_in_16S)

# -------------------------------
# Restrict to shared samples ONLY
# -------------------------------
shared_ids <- intersect(samples_16S, samples_met)

cat("\nSample counts:\n")
cat("  16S total:", length(samples_16S), "\n")
cat("  Metabolomics total:", length(samples_met), "\n")
cat("  Used for integration:", length(shared_ids), "\n")

# Subset all objects
genus_clr <- genus_clr[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
metab_mat <- metab_mat[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta_pre  <- meta_pre %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% shared_ids) %>%
  arrange(match(SampleID, shared_ids))

# Final alignment check (MUST be TRUE)
stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(genus_clr), rownames(metab_mat)),
  identical(rownames(genus_clr), meta_pre$SampleID)
)

cat("\nFinal aligned dimensions:\n")
cat("  genus_clr:", paste(dim(genus_clr), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("  metab_mat:", paste(dim(metab_mat), collapse = " x "), "\n")


#==============================================================================================================================
This version uses FeatureID/ASV IDs for selection, then collapses those matched features into a single genus-level abundance per sample. It also saves:

a long per-sample CSV

a wide sample-by-feature CSV

a summary stats CSV

the plot files

```{r}

```




```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)

# ==========================================
# USER INPUT
# ==========================================
genus_of_interest <- "Butyricicoccus"   # can also use "lacto"
last_time_point   <- "T6"              # change if needed
out_dir <- "Genus_FinalTimepoint_Comparisons"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

genus_safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", genus_of_interest)
tp_safe    <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", last_time_point)

plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("Genus_", genus_safe, "_", tp_safe))
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# optional: set treatment order if you want consistency
treatment_order <- c("Vehicle", "Haloperidol", "Quetiapine", "Olanzapine", "Risperidone")

# ==========================================
# 1. Taxonomy table and FeatureID matching
# ==========================================
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID")

tax_df$Genus <- as.character(tax_df$Genus)
tax_df$Genus[is.na(tax_df$Genus) |
               tax_df$Genus == "" |
               tolower(tax_df$Genus) %in% c("none", "unclassified", "unknown")] <- "Unclassified"

matched_taxa <- tax_df %>%
  filter(str_detect(tolower(Genus), tolower(genus_of_interest)))

if (nrow(matched_taxa) == 0) {
  cat("No matching genus found.\n\nAvailable genus names:\n")
  print(sort(unique(tax_df$Genus)))
  stop(paste("Genus not found:", genus_of_interest))
}

feature_ids <- matched_taxa$FeatureID

cat("Matched genus labels:\n")
print(unique(matched_taxa$Genus))
cat("\nNumber of matched FeatureIDs:", length(feature_ids), "\n")

write.csv(
  matched_taxa,
  file = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Matched_FeatureIDs_", genus_safe, ".csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==========================================
# 2. Subset to matched features and final time point
# ==========================================
ps_sub <- prune_taxa(feature_ids, ps)
ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps_sub, Time_Point == last_time_point)
ps_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)

if (nsamples(ps_sub) == 0) {
  stop(paste("No samples found at time point:", last_time_point))
}
if (ntaxa(ps_sub) == 0) {
  stop("No matched taxa remained after subsetting.")
}

# ==========================================
# 3. Extract raw abundance matrix
#    (collapsed later across matched FeatureIDs)
# ==========================================
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_sub), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_sub)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID")

meta_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_sub), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID")

# ==========================================
# 4. LONG feature-level table
# ==========================================
long_feature_df <- otu_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -SampleID,
    names_to = "FeatureID",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    matched_taxa %>% select(any_of(c("FeatureID","Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species"))),
    by = "FeatureID"
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "SampleID")

write.csv(
  long_feature_df,
  file = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Genus_", genus_safe, "_", tp_safe, "_LONG_feature_level.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==========================================
# 5. WIDE sample x FeatureID table
# ==========================================
wide_feature_df <- otu_df %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "SampleID")

write.csv(
  wide_feature_df,
  file = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Genus_", genus_safe, "_", tp_safe, "_WIDE_feature_level.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==========================================
# 6. Collapse matched FeatureIDs to one value per sample
# ==========================================
sample_genus_df <- long_feature_df %>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(
    GenusQuery = genus_of_interest,
    Time_Point = last_time_point
  )

if ("TreatmentGroup" %in% colnames(sample_genus_df)) {
  sample_genus_df$TreatmentGroup <- factor(
    sample_genus_df$TreatmentGroup,
    levels = intersect(treatment_order, unique(sample_genus_df$TreatmentGroup))
  )
}

sample_genus_df %>%
  group_by(TreatmentGroup) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    non_missing = sum(!is.na(Abundance)),
    unique_vals = n_distinct(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    all_zero = all(Abundance == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  sample_genus_df,
  file = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Genus_", genus_safe, "_", tp_safe, "_LONG_collapsed_samples.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==========================================
# 7. Summary stats by treatment group
# ==========================================
summary_df <- sample_genus_df %>%
  group_by(TreatmentGroup) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(Abundance)),
    mean_abund = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abund = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abund = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_abund = sd_abund / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  summary_df,
  file = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Genus_", genus_safe, "_", tp_safe, "_summary_stats.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==========================================
# 8. Overall + pairwise stats
#    Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon
# ==========================================
# ==========================================
# 8. Overall + pairwise stats
#    Kruskal-Wallis + robust pairwise Wilcoxon
# ==========================================

# clean table first
stats_df <- sample_genus_df %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, TreatmentGroup, Abundance) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TreatmentGroup), !is.na(Abundance)) %>%
  mutate(TreatmentGroup = droplevels(factor(TreatmentGroup)))

# optional diagnostic
group_check <- stats_df %>%
  group_by(TreatmentGroup) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_unique = n_distinct(Abundance),
    min_abund = min(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abund = max(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(group_check)

# Kruskal-Wallis
kw_res <- stats_df %>%
  kruskal_test(Abundance ~ TreatmentGroup)

# robust pairwise Wilcoxon
valid_groups <- stats_df %>%
  group_by(TreatmentGroup) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_unique = n_distinct(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 2) %>%
  pull(TreatmentGroup) %>%
  as.character()

pairwise_df <- stats_df %>%
  filter(TreatmentGroup %in% valid_groups) %>%
  mutate(TreatmentGroup = droplevels(factor(TreatmentGroup)))

group_pairs <- combn(unique(as.character(pairwise_df$TreatmentGroup)), 2, simplify = FALSE)

pairwise_list <- lapply(group_pairs, function(g) {
  sub <- pairwise_df %>%
    filter(TreatmentGroup %in% g)

  x <- sub$Abundance[sub$TreatmentGroup == g[1]]
  y <- sub$Abundance[sub$TreatmentGroup == g[2]]

  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  y <- y[!is.na(y)]

  # skip broken comparisons
  if (length(x) < 1 || length(y) < 1) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # wilcox can still behave oddly in degenerate cases, so wrap safely
  wt <- tryCatch(
    wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(wt)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tibble(
    group1 = g[1],
    group2 = g[2],
    p = wt$p.value
  )
})

pairwise_res <- bind_rows(pairwise_list)

if (nrow(pairwise_res) > 0) {
  pairwise_res <- pairwise_res %>%
    mutate(
      p.adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
      p.adj.signif = case_when(
        p.adj <= 0.0001 ~ "****",
        p.adj <= 0.001  ~ "***",
        p.adj <= 0.01   ~ "**",
        p.adj <= 0.05   ~ "*",
        TRUE            ~ "ns"
      )
    )
} else {
  pairwise_res <- tibble(
    group1 = character(),
    group2 = character(),
    p = numeric(),
    p.adj = numeric(),
    p.adj.signif = character()
  )
}

write.csv(
  kw_res,
  file = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Genus_", genus_safe, "_", tp_safe, "_kruskal_wallis.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  pairwise_res,
  file = file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Genus_", genus_safe, "_", tp_safe, "_pairwise_wilcox.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)
# ==========================================
# 9. Plot
# ==========================================
y_max <- max(stats_df$Abundance, na.rm = TRUE)

sig_pairs <- pairwise_res %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(p.adj)

if (nrow(sig_pairs) > 0) {
  sig_pairs <- sig_pairs %>%
    mutate(
      y.position = y_max * (1.05 + 0.08 * row_number()),
      label = paste0("BH p = ", signif(p.adj, 2))
    )
}

p <- ggplot(stats_df, aes(x = TreatmentGroup, y = Abundance, fill = TreatmentGroup)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.65, width = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(genus_of_interest, " abundance at ", last_time_point),
    subtitle = paste0("Collapsed from ", length(feature_ids), " matched FeatureIDs"),
    x = "Treatment Group",
    y = "Abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

if (nrow(sig_pairs) > 0) {
  p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(
    sig_pairs,
    label = "label",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    bracket.size = 0.3,
    size = 3
  )
}

print(p)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Genus_", genus_safe, "_", tp_safe, "_boxplot.pdf")),
  p, width = 8, height = 6
)

ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir, paste0("Genus_", genus_safe, "_", tp_safe, "_boxplot.tiff")),
  p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# DIABLO pipeline: T6, genus-level 16S + annotated metabolites
# Built for:
#   ps = phyloseq object
#   annotated metabolite file with:
#     row 1 = sample names
#     row 2 = group labels
#     row 3+ = metabolite intensities
# Output:
#   tuned DIABLO model + plots + exports
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(microbiome)
  library(mixOmics)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(BiocParallel)
})

# -----------------------------
# 0. settings
# -----------------------------
pre_tp <- "T6"
out_dir <- file.path(root.dir, "DIABLO_T6_AnnotatedOnly")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

set.seed(123)

# microbiome filtering
genus_prevalence_cutoff <- 0.15
genus_variance_quantile <- 0.10

# metabolite filtering
met_missing_prop_max <- 0.20
met_variance_quantile <- 0.10

# DIABLO tuning grid
ncomp_test <- 2
test_keepX_microbe <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 30)
test_keepX_metab   <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 30)

# treatment order
treatment_levels <- c("Vehicle", "Haloperidol", "Quetiapine", "Olanzapine", "Risperidone")

# -----------------------------
# helper: sample ID cleaning
# -----------------------------
clean_id <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace("\\.mzXML$", "") %>%
    str_replace("\\.mzML$", "") %>%
    str_replace("_01$", "") %>%
    str_trim()
}

# ============================================================
# 1. subset phyloseq to T6
# ============================================================
ps_t6 <- subset_samples(ps, Time_Point == pre_tp)
ps_t6 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_t6) > 0, ps_t6)

meta_16s <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_t6), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = clean_id(SampleID),
    TreatmentGroup = as.character(TreatmentGroup),
    Time_Point = as.character(Time_Point)
  )

cat("T6 16S samples:", nrow(meta_16s), "\n")
print(table(meta_16s$TreatmentGroup))

# ============================================================
# 2. build genus-level CLR matrix
# ============================================================
ps_genus <- tax_glom(ps_t6, taxrank = "Genus")
ps_genus <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_genus) > 0, ps_genus)

genus_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_genus), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_genus)) genus_mat <- t(genus_mat)

# enforce sample IDs
rownames(genus_mat) <- clean_id(rownames(genus_mat))

genus_tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_genus)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID")

genus_names <- as.character(genus_tax$Genus)
genus_names[is.na(genus_names) | genus_names == "" |
              tolower(genus_names) %in% c("none", "unclassified", "unknown")] <- "Unclassified"
colnames(genus_mat) <- make.unique(genus_names)

# prevalence filter
genus_prev <- colMeans(genus_mat > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_genera_prev <- names(genus_prev[genus_prev >= genus_prevalence_cutoff])
genus_mat_f <- genus_mat[, keep_genera_prev, drop = FALSE]

# preserve sample IDs through CLR
genus_sample_ids <- rownames(genus_mat_f)

genus_clr <- microbiome::transform(genus_mat_f, "clr")
genus_clr <- as.matrix(genus_clr)
rownames(genus_clr) <- genus_sample_ids

# low-variance filter
genus_var <- apply(genus_clr, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
genus_keep_var <- genus_var > quantile(genus_var, genus_variance_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
genus_clr <- genus_clr[, genus_keep_var, drop = FALSE]

# remove any residual bad columns
genus_clr <- genus_clr[, apply(genus_clr, 2, function(x) all(is.finite(x))), drop = FALSE]
genus_clr <- genus_clr[, apply(genus_clr, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]

cat("Genus CLR matrix:", dim(genus_clr)[1], "samples x", dim(genus_clr)[2], "genera\n")
cat("Example 16S IDs:\n")
print(head(rownames(genus_clr), 10))

# ============================================================
# 3. prepare annotated metabolite matrix
# ============================================================
met_file <- "D:/OneDrive - Emory/Research/LCMS/Gacasan_Mouse_Stool_Antipsychotics_JW_12282025/hilicpos/Merge/Annotated_Metaboanalyst_Post.csv"

met_raw <- read.csv(
  met_file,
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

cat("Raw metabolite table dimensions:", dim(met_raw), "\n")
stopifnot(colnames(met_raw)[1] == "Name")

# -----------------------------
# 3A. extract group row
# -----------------------------
group_row <- met_raw[1, , drop = FALSE]

sample_cols_met <- colnames(met_raw)[-1]
sample_group_labels <- as.character(group_row[1, -1])

group_key <- tibble(
  RawSample = sample_cols_met,
  RawGroup  = sample_group_labels
)

# -----------------------------
# 3B. remove group row, keep metabolite data
# -----------------------------
met_tbl <- met_raw[-1, , drop = FALSE]
met_tbl$Name <- make.unique(as.character(met_tbl$Name))

# -----------------------------
# 3C. matrix of metabolites x samples
# -----------------------------
met_mat <- met_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(Name, all_of(sample_cols_met))

rownames(met_mat) <- met_mat$Name
met_mat <- met_mat[, -1, drop = FALSE]
met_mat <- as.matrix(met_mat)
mode(met_mat) <- "numeric"

# transpose to samples x metabolites
met_mat_num <- t(met_mat)
rownames(met_mat_num) <- clean_id(rownames(met_mat_num))

cat("Metabolite matrix after transpose:", dim(met_mat_num)[1], "samples x", dim(met_mat_num)[2], "metabolites\n")
cat("Example metabolomics IDs:\n")
print(head(rownames(met_mat_num), 10))

# -----------------------------
# 3D. metabolomics sample key
# -----------------------------
group_key <- group_key %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = clean_id(RawSample),
    TreatmentGroup = case_when(
      str_starts(RawGroup, "H_") ~ "Haloperidol",
      str_starts(RawGroup, "O_") ~ "Olanzapine",
      str_starts(RawGroup, "Q_") ~ "Quetiapine",
      str_starts(RawGroup, "R_") ~ "Risperidone",
      str_starts(RawGroup, "V_") ~ "Vehicle",
      TRUE ~ RawGroup
    ),
    Time_Point = pre_tp
  )

write.csv(group_key, file.path(out_dir, "metabolite_sample_key.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# 3E. metabolite QC/filtering
# -----------------------------
met_missing_prop <- colMeans(is.na(met_mat_num))
met_mat_f <- met_mat_num[, met_missing_prop <= met_missing_prop_max, drop = FALSE]

# half-min imputation per metabolite
for (j in seq_len(ncol(met_mat_f))) {
  x <- met_mat_f[, j]
  if (anyNA(x)) {
    nonmiss <- x[!is.na(x) & x > 0]
    fill_val <- if (length(nonmiss) > 0) min(nonmiss) / 2 else 1e-6
    x[is.na(x)] <- fill_val
    met_mat_f[, j] <- x
  }
}

# log2 transform
met_log <- log2(met_mat_f + 1)

# low variance filter
met_var <- apply(met_log, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
met_keep_var <- met_var > quantile(met_var, met_variance_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
met_log <- met_log[, met_keep_var, drop = FALSE]

# preserve dimnames through scale
met_sample_ids <- rownames(met_log)
met_feature_ids <- colnames(met_log)

met_scaled <- scale(met_log)
met_scaled <- as.matrix(met_scaled)
rownames(met_scaled) <- met_sample_ids
colnames(met_scaled) <- met_feature_ids

# remove bad columns
met_scaled <- met_scaled[, apply(met_scaled, 2, function(x) all(is.finite(x))), drop = FALSE]
met_scaled <- met_scaled[, apply(met_scaled, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]

cat("Filtered metabolite matrix:", dim(met_scaled)[1], "samples x", dim(met_scaled)[2], "metabolites\n")

write.csv(
  data.frame(SampleID = rownames(met_scaled), met_scaled, check.names = FALSE),
  file.path(out_dir, "metabolome_annotated_scaled_matrix.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 4. align shared samples at T6 using canonical IDs
# ============================================================

# -----------------------------
# 4A. Build canonical ID for 16S
# -----------------------------
if (!("Mouse_Number" %in% colnames(meta_16s))) {
  stop("meta_16s does not contain Mouse_Number.")
}

meta_16s_key <- meta_16s %>%
  mutate(
    TreatmentCode = case_when(
      TreatmentGroup == "Haloperidol" ~ "H",
      TreatmentGroup == "Olanzapine"  ~ "O",
      TreatmentGroup == "Quetiapine"  ~ "Q",
      TreatmentGroup == "Risperidone" ~ "R",
      TreatmentGroup == "Vehicle"     ~ "V",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Mouse_Number = as.character(Mouse_Number),
    CanonicalID = paste0(TreatmentCode, "_", Mouse_Number)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SampleID,
    TreatmentGroup,
    Time_Point,
    Mouse_Number,
    CanonicalID
  )

cat("16S canonical IDs:\n")
print(meta_16s_key %>% dplyr::select(SampleID, CanonicalID) %>% head(10))

# -----------------------------
# 4B. Build canonical ID for metabolomics
# Example: H_Post_1 -> H_1
# -----------------------------
meta_met_key <- group_key %>%
  mutate(
    Mouse_Number = str_extract(SampleID, "(?<=_)[0-9]+$"),
    TreatmentCode = str_extract(SampleID, "^[A-Z]"),
    CanonicalID = paste0(TreatmentCode, "_", Mouse_Number)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SampleID,
    TreatmentGroup,
    Time_Point,
    Mouse_Number,
    CanonicalID
  )

cat("Metabolomics canonical IDs:\n")
print(meta_met_key %>% dplyr::select(SampleID, CanonicalID) %>% head(10))

# -----------------------------
# 4C. Attach canonical IDs to matrices
# -----------------------------
genus_rownames <- rownames(genus_clr)
met_rownames   <- rownames(met_scaled)

genus_map <- tibble(SampleID = genus_rownames) %>%
  left_join(meta_16s_key, by = "SampleID")

met_map <- tibble(SampleID = met_rownames) %>%
  left_join(meta_met_key, by = "SampleID")

# diagnostics
cat("16S rows missing CanonicalID:", sum(is.na(genus_map$CanonicalID)), "\n")
cat("Metabolomics rows missing CanonicalID:", sum(is.na(met_map$CanonicalID)), "\n")

if (any(is.na(genus_map$CanonicalID))) {
  cat("16S samples missing CanonicalID:\n")
  print(genus_map %>% filter(is.na(CanonicalID)))
}

if (any(is.na(met_map$CanonicalID))) {
  cat("Metabolomics samples missing CanonicalID:\n")
  print(met_map %>% filter(is.na(CanonicalID)))
}

# -----------------------------
# 4D. Find shared canonical IDs
# -----------------------------
common_ids <- intersect(
  genus_map$CanonicalID,
  met_map$CanonicalID
)

common_ids <- common_ids[!is.na(common_ids)]

cat("Shared canonical IDs:", length(common_ids), "\n")
print(common_ids)

if (length(common_ids) < 5) {
  stop("Too few shared samples found after canonical ID matching.")
}

# -----------------------------
# 4E. Reorder matrices by shared canonical IDs
# -----------------------------
genus_keep <- genus_map %>%
  filter(CanonicalID %in% common_ids) %>%
  arrange(match(CanonicalID, common_ids))

met_keep <- met_map %>%
  filter(CanonicalID %in% common_ids) %>%
  arrange(match(CanonicalID, common_ids))

genus_clr_aligned <- genus_clr[genus_keep$SampleID, , drop = FALSE]
met_scaled_aligned <- met_scaled[met_keep$SampleID, , drop = FALSE]

# rename rownames to canonical IDs so both blocks match exactly
rownames(genus_clr_aligned) <- genus_keep$CanonicalID
rownames(met_scaled_aligned) <- met_keep$CanonicalID

# -----------------------------
# 4F. Build final metadata for DIABLO
# -----------------------------
meta_diablo <- genus_keep %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SampleID_16S = SampleID,
    TreatmentGroup,
    Time_Point,
    Mouse_Number,
    CanonicalID
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    met_keep %>%
      dplyr::select(
        CanonicalID,
        SampleID_Metabolomics = SampleID
      ),
    by = "CanonicalID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TreatmentGroup = factor(TreatmentGroup, levels = treatment_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(CanonicalID, common_ids))

# final checks
stopifnot(identical(meta_diablo$CanonicalID, rownames(genus_clr_aligned)))
stopifnot(identical(meta_diablo$CanonicalID, rownames(met_scaled_aligned)))

# overwrite the originals used downstream
genus_clr  <- genus_clr_aligned
met_scaled <- met_scaled_aligned

write.csv(meta_diablo, file.path(out_dir, "DIABLO_metadata_used.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Final aligned sample counts by treatment:\n")
print(table(meta_diablo$TreatmentGroup))

# ============================================================
# 5. build DIABLO input blocks
# ============================================================
X <- list(
  microbiome = genus_clr,
  metabolome = met_scaled
)

Y <- meta_diablo$TreatmentGroup
names(Y) <- meta_diablo$CanonicalID

design <- matrix(c(
  0,   0.1,
  0.1, 0
), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
colnames(design) <- rownames(design) <- names(X)

print(design)

# cap keepX at available features
test_keepX_microbe_use <- test_keepX_microbe[test_keepX_microbe <= ncol(X$microbiome)]
test_keepX_metab_use   <- test_keepX_metab[test_keepX_metab <= ncol(X$metabolome)]

if (length(test_keepX_microbe_use) == 0) test_keepX_microbe_use <- min(5, ncol(X$microbiome))
if (length(test_keepX_metab_use) == 0)   test_keepX_metab_use   <- min(5, ncol(X$metabolome))

init_keep_microbe <- min(20, ncol(X$microbiome))
init_keep_metab   <- min(20, ncol(X$metabolome))

# ============================================================
# 6. quick initial model
# ============================================================
diablo_init <- block.splsda(
  X = X,
  Y = Y,
  ncomp = ncomp_test,
  keepX = list(
    microbiome = rep(init_keep_microbe, ncomp_test),
    metabolome = rep(init_keep_metab, ncomp_test)
  ),
  design = design
)

saveRDS(diablo_init, file.path(out_dir, "diablo_initial_model.rds"))

# ============================================================
# 7. tune keepX
# ============================================================
tune_diablo <- tune.block.splsda(
  X = X,
  Y = Y,
  ncomp = ncomp_test,
  test.keepX = list(
    microbiome = test_keepX_microbe_use,
    metabolome = test_keepX_metab_use
  ),
  design = design,
  validation = "Mfold",
  folds = 5,
  nrepeat = 20,
  dist = "centroids.dist",
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

saveRDS(tune_diablo, file.path(out_dir, "diablo_tuning_results.rds"))

keepX_opt <- tune_diablo$choice.keepX
print(keepX_opt)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    block = rep(names(keepX_opt), each = length(keepX_opt[[1]])),
    component = rep(seq_along(keepX_opt[[1]]), times = length(keepX_opt)),
    keepX = unlist(keepX_opt)
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, "diablo_optimal_keepX.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 8. fit tuned final model
# ============================================================
diablo_final <- block.splsda(
  X = X,
  Y = Y,
  ncomp = ncomp_test,
  keepX = keepX_opt,
  design = design
)

saveRDS(diablo_final, file.path(out_dir, "diablo_final_model.rds"))

# ============================================================
# 9. performance assessment
# ============================================================
perf_diablo <- perf(
  diablo_final,
  validation = "Mfold",
  folds = 5,
  nrepeat = 20,
  dist = "centroids.dist",
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

saveRDS(perf_diablo, file.path(out_dir, "diablo_performance.rds"))
```

# ============================================================
# 10. selected features export
# ============================================================
extract_selected_vars <- function(model, block, comp) {
  sv <- selectVar(model, block = block, comp = comp)

  # Case 1: preferred path using $name and $value
  feats <- NULL
  vals  <- NULL

  if (!is.null(sv$name)) {
    feats <- sv$name
    if (is.list(feats)) feats <- feats[[comp]]
  }

  if (!is.null(sv$value)) {
    vals <- sv$value
    if (is.list(vals)) {
      vals <- vals[[comp]]
    } else if (is.matrix(vals) || is.data.frame(vals)) {
      # if rows are features, use rownames + first numeric column
      vals_df <- as.data.frame(vals, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      if (nrow(vals_df) > 0) {
        if (is.null(feats) || length(feats) == 0) {
          feats <- rownames(vals_df)
        }
        vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals_df[[1]]))
      } else {
        vals <- numeric(0)
      }
    } else {
      vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))
    }
  }

  # clean up empty results
  if (is.null(feats) || length(feats) == 0) {
    feats <- character(0)
  }
  if (is.null(vals) || length(vals) == 0) {
    vals <- numeric(0)
  }

  # harmonize lengths
  n <- min(length(feats), length(vals))

  if (n == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      Feature = character(0),
      Loading = numeric(0),
      block = character(0),
      component = integer(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  out <- data.frame(
    Feature = as.character(feats[seq_len(n)]),
    Loading = as.numeric(vals[seq_len(n)]),
    block = rep(block, n),
    component = rep(comp, n),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out
}

sel_microbe <- extract_selected_vars(diablo_final, block = "microbiome", comp = 1)

if (ncomp_test >= 2) {

  write.csv(sel_microbe_c2, file.path(out_dir, "selected_microbiome_comp2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(sel_metab_c2,   file.path(out_dir, "selected_metabolome_comp2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("Selected features exported.\n")

# ============================================================
