```{r}
# ============================================================
# Volcano plots from precomputed stats tables
# Creates:
#   1) annotated volcano plots (top 10 labeled metabolites)
#   2) unannotated volcano plots
# For:
#   Haloperidol, Olanzapine, Quetiapine, Risperidone, Vehicle
#
# Points are colored by drug group.
# Significant points are highlighted, with standard threshold lines at:
#   |log2FC| = 1
#   p = 0.05
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggrepel)
})

# -----------------------------
# Input/output directories
# -----------------------------
in_dir <- "D:/OneDrive - Emory/Research/LCMS/Gacasan_Mouse_Stool_Antipsychotics_JW_12282025/hilicpos/Merge/VolcanoPlots_PreVsPost"
out_dir <- file.path(in_dir, "VolcanoPlots_Annotated_Unannotated")

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# Drug colors
# -----------------------------
drug_cols <- c(
  Vehicle      = "#000000",
  Risperidone  = "#B69D71",
  Quetiapine   = "#E3DED4",
  Olanzapine   = "#70AFC7",
  Haloperidol  = "#4F5357"
)

# -----------------------------
# Files
# -----------------------------
csv_files <- list.files(
  in_dir,
  pattern = "^volcano_stats_.*_PostVsPre\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# -----------------------------
# Helper functions
# -----------------------------
extract_group <- function(x) {
  x |>
    basename() |>
    str_remove("^volcano_stats_") |>
    str_remove("_PostVsPre\\.csv$")
}

# Heuristic for annotated metabolite names
is_annotated_name <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  !is.na(x) &
    x != "" &
    !x %in% c("NA", "na", "N/A", "Unknown", "unknown", "Unannotated", "unannotated") &
    !str_detect(x, "^mz[_:.]") &
    !str_detect(x, "^[0-9.]+_[0-9.]+$") &
    !str_detect(x, "^[0-9.]+@[0-9.]+$") &
    !str_detect(x, "^[Mm]/?[Zz]") &
    !str_detect(x, "^[Xx][0-9]+$")
}

make_volcano_plot <- function(df, group_name, annotate = FALSE, n_label = 10) {

  group_col <- drug_cols[[group_name]]
  if (is.null(group_col)) group_col <- "black"

  # Basic cleanup
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Name = as.character(Name),
      mean_pre = as.numeric(mean_pre),
      mean_post = as.numeric(mean_post),
      log2FC = as.numeric(log2FC),
      p_value = as.numeric(p_value),
      fdr = as.numeric(fdr),
      neglog10p = as.numeric(neglog10p),
      neglog10fdr = as.numeric(neglog10fdr),
      sig = as.character(sig)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(log2FC), !is.na(neglog10p), !is.na(p_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      highlight = abs(log2FC) >= 1 & p_value < 0.05
    )

  # Top 10 annotated metabolites by smallest p-value, then largest |log2FC|
  label_df <- df %>%
    filter(is_annotated_name(Name)) %>%
    arrange(p_value, desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_label)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = neglog10p)) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-1, 1),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df %>% filter(!highlight),
      color = group_col,
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df %>% filter(highlight),
      color = group_col,
      size = 2.6,
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(group_name, " Post vs Pre"),
      x = expression(log[2]~fold~change),
      y = expression(-log[10]~italic(p))
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )

  if (annotate && nrow(label_df) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = label_df,
        aes(label = Name),
        size = 3.2,
        box.padding = 0.35,
        point.padding = 0.2,
        segment.size = 0.3,
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        min.segment.length = 0
      )
  }

  p
}

# -----------------------------
# Generate plots
# -----------------------------
for (f in csv_files) {

  group_name <- extract_group(f)

  df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

  p_unannotated <- make_volcano_plot(df, group_name, annotate = FALSE, n_label = 10)
  p_annotated   <- make_volcano_plot(df, group_name, annotate = TRUE,  n_label = 10)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("Volcano_", group_name, "_PostVsPre_unannotated.png")),
    plot = p_unannotated,
    width = 7,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("Volcano_", group_name, "_PostVsPre_unannotated.pdf")),
    plot = p_unannotated,
    width = 7,
    height = 6
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("Volcano_", group_name, "_PostVsPre_annotated_top10.png")),
    plot = p_annotated,
    width = 8.5,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("Volcano_", group_name, "_PostVsPre_annotated_top10.pdf")),
    plot = p_annotated,
    width = 8.5,
    height = 7
  )
}

message("Done. Plots saved to: ", out_dir)
print(list.files(out_dir))
```







```{r}
# ============================================================
# DIABLO pipeline: T6, genus-level 16S + annotated metabolites
# Rewritten so circos feature summaries are shown as dodged bar plots
# instead of outer radial lines above the circle
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(phyloseq)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(microbiome)
  library(mixOmics)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(patchwork)
})

# -----------------------------
# 0. settings
# -----------------------------
pre_tp <- "T6"
out_dir <- file.path(root.dir, "DIABLO_T6_AnnotatedOnly_BarplotVersion")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

set.seed(123)

# microbiome filtering
genus_prevalence_cutoff <- 0.15
genus_variance_quantile <- 0.10

# metabolite filtering
met_missing_prop_max <- 0.20
met_variance_quantile <- 0.10

# DIABLO tuning grid
ncomp_test <- 2
test_keepX_microbe <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 30)
test_keepX_metab   <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 30)

# treatment order
treatment_levels <- c("Vehicle", "Haloperidol", "Quetiapine", "Olanzapine", "Risperidone")

# treatment colors
drug_cols <- c(
  "Vehicle"      = "#000000",
  "Risperidone"  = "#B69D71",
  "Quetiapine"   = "#E3DED4",
  "Olanzapine"   = "#70AFC7",
  "Haloperidol"  = "#4F5357"
)

# number of selected features to show in bar plots
top_n_barplot <- 15

# -----------------------------
# helper: sample ID cleaning
# -----------------------------
clean_id <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace("\\.mzXML$", "") %>%
    str_replace("\\.mzML$", "") %>%
    str_replace("_01$", "") %>%
    str_trim()
}

# helper: mean ± SEM summary
summarize_mean_sem <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(TreatmentGroup, Feature) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sem  = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Value))),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 1. subset phyloseq to T6
# ============================================================
ps_t6 <- subset_samples(ps, Time_Point == pre_tp)
ps_t6 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_t6) > 0, ps_t6)

meta_16s <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_t6), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = clean_id(SampleID),
    TreatmentGroup = as.character(TreatmentGroup),
    Time_Point = as.character(Time_Point)
  )

cat("T6 16S samples:", nrow(meta_16s), "\n")
print(table(meta_16s$TreatmentGroup))

# ============================================================
# 2. build genus-level CLR matrix
# ============================================================
ps_genus <- tax_glom(ps_t6, taxrank = "Genus")
ps_genus <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_genus) > 0, ps_genus)

genus_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_genus), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_genus)) genus_mat <- t(genus_mat)

rownames(genus_mat) <- clean_id(rownames(genus_mat))

genus_tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_genus)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID")

genus_names <- as.character(genus_tax$Genus)
genus_names[is.na(genus_names) | genus_names == "" |
              tolower(genus_names) %in% c("none", "unclassified", "unknown")] <- "Unclassified"
colnames(genus_mat) <- make.unique(genus_names)

# prevalence filter
genus_prev <- colMeans(genus_mat > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
keep_genera_prev <- names(genus_prev[genus_prev >= genus_prevalence_cutoff])
genus_mat_f <- genus_mat[, keep_genera_prev, drop = FALSE]

# preserve sample IDs through CLR
genus_sample_ids <- rownames(genus_mat_f)

genus_clr <- microbiome::transform(genus_mat_f, "clr")
genus_clr <- as.matrix(genus_clr)
rownames(genus_clr) <- genus_sample_ids

# low variance filter
genus_var <- apply(genus_clr, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
genus_keep_var <- genus_var > quantile(genus_var, genus_variance_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
genus_clr <- genus_clr[, genus_keep_var, drop = FALSE]

# remove bad columns
genus_clr <- genus_clr[, apply(genus_clr, 2, function(x) all(is.finite(x))), drop = FALSE]
genus_clr <- genus_clr[, apply(genus_clr, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]

cat("Genus CLR matrix:", dim(genus_clr)[1], "samples x", dim(genus_clr)[2], "genera\n")

# ============================================================
# 3. prepare annotated metabolite matrix
# ============================================================
met_file <- "D:/OneDrive - Emory/Research/LCMS/Gacasan_Mouse_Stool_Antipsychotics_JW_12282025/hilicpos/Merge/Annotated_Metaboanalyst_Post.csv"

met_raw <- read.csv(
  met_file,
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

cat("Raw metabolite table dimensions:", dim(met_raw), "\n")
stopifnot(colnames(met_raw)[1] == "Name")

# -----------------------------
# 3A. extract group row
# -----------------------------
group_row <- met_raw[1, , drop = FALSE]

sample_cols_met <- colnames(met_raw)[-1]
sample_group_labels <- as.character(group_row[1, -1])

group_key <- tibble(
  RawSample = sample_cols_met,
  RawGroup  = sample_group_labels
)

# -----------------------------
# 3B. remove group row
# -----------------------------
met_tbl <- met_raw[-1, , drop = FALSE]
met_tbl$Name <- make.unique(as.character(met_tbl$Name))

# -----------------------------
# 3C. matrix of metabolites x samples
# -----------------------------
met_mat <- met_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(Name, all_of(sample_cols_met))

rownames(met_mat) <- met_mat$Name
met_mat <- met_mat[, -1, drop = FALSE]
met_mat <- as.matrix(met_mat)
mode(met_mat) <- "numeric"

# transpose to samples x metabolites
met_mat_num <- t(met_mat)
rownames(met_mat_num) <- clean_id(rownames(met_mat_num))

cat("Metabolite matrix after transpose:", dim(met_mat_num)[1], "samples x", dim(met_mat_num)[2], "metabolites\n")

# -----------------------------
# 3D. metabolomics sample key
# -----------------------------
group_key <- group_key %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID = clean_id(RawSample),
    TreatmentGroup = case_when(
      str_starts(RawGroup, "H_") ~ "Haloperidol",
      str_starts(RawGroup, "O_") ~ "Olanzapine",
      str_starts(RawGroup, "Q_") ~ "Quetiapine",
      str_starts(RawGroup, "R_") ~ "Risperidone",
      str_starts(RawGroup, "V_") ~ "Vehicle",
      TRUE ~ RawGroup
    ),
    Time_Point = pre_tp
  )

write.csv(group_key, file.path(out_dir, "metabolite_sample_key.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# -----------------------------
# 3E. metabolite QC/filtering
# -----------------------------
met_missing_prop <- colMeans(is.na(met_mat_num))
met_mat_f <- met_mat_num[, met_missing_prop <= met_missing_prop_max, drop = FALSE]

# half-min imputation per metabolite
for (j in seq_len(ncol(met_mat_f))) {
  x <- met_mat_f[, j]
  if (anyNA(x)) {
    nonmiss <- x[!is.na(x) & x > 0]
    fill_val <- if (length(nonmiss) > 0) min(nonmiss) / 2 else 1e-6
    x[is.na(x)] <- fill_val
    met_mat_f[, j] <- x
  }
}

# log2 transform
met_log <- log2(met_mat_f + 1)

# low variance filter
met_var <- apply(met_log, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
met_keep_var <- met_var > quantile(met_var, met_variance_quantile, na.rm = TRUE)
met_log <- met_log[, met_keep_var, drop = FALSE]

# preserve dimnames through scale
met_sample_ids <- rownames(met_log)
met_feature_ids <- colnames(met_log)

met_scaled <- scale(met_log)
met_scaled <- as.matrix(met_scaled)
rownames(met_scaled) <- met_sample_ids
colnames(met_scaled) <- met_feature_ids

# remove bad columns
met_scaled <- met_scaled[, apply(met_scaled, 2, function(x) all(is.finite(x))), drop = FALSE]
met_scaled <- met_scaled[, apply(met_scaled, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]

cat("Filtered metabolite matrix:", dim(met_scaled)[1], "samples x", dim(met_scaled)[2], "metabolites\n")

write.csv(
  data.frame(SampleID = rownames(met_scaled), met_scaled, check.names = FALSE),
  file.path(out_dir, "metabolome_annotated_scaled_matrix.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 4. align shared samples at T6 using canonical IDs
# ============================================================
if (!("Mouse_Number" %in% colnames(meta_16s))) {
  stop("meta_16s does not contain Mouse_Number.")
}

# 16S key
meta_16s_key <- meta_16s %>%
  mutate(
    TreatmentCode = case_when(
      TreatmentGroup == "Haloperidol" ~ "H",
      TreatmentGroup == "Olanzapine"  ~ "O",
      TreatmentGroup == "Quetiapine"  ~ "Q",
      TreatmentGroup == "Risperidone" ~ "R",
      TreatmentGroup == "Vehicle"     ~ "V",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Mouse_Number = as.character(Mouse_Number),
    CanonicalID = paste0(TreatmentCode, "_", Mouse_Number)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SampleID,
    TreatmentGroup,
    Time_Point,
    Mouse_Number,
    CanonicalID
  )

# metabolomics key
meta_met_key <- group_key %>%
  mutate(
    Mouse_Number = str_extract(SampleID, "(?<=_)[0-9]+$"),
    TreatmentCode = str_extract(SampleID, "^[A-Z]"),
    CanonicalID = paste0(TreatmentCode, "_", Mouse_Number)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SampleID,
    TreatmentGroup,
    Time_Point,
    Mouse_Number,
    CanonicalID
  )

# attach canonical IDs
genus_rownames <- rownames(genus_clr)
met_rownames   <- rownames(met_scaled)

genus_map <- tibble(SampleID = genus_rownames) %>%
  left_join(meta_16s_key, by = "SampleID")

met_map <- tibble(SampleID = met_rownames) %>%
  left_join(meta_met_key, by = "SampleID")

cat("16S rows missing CanonicalID:", sum(is.na(genus_map$CanonicalID)), "\n")
cat("Metabolomics rows missing CanonicalID:", sum(is.na(met_map$CanonicalID)), "\n")

# shared IDs
common_ids <- intersect(genus_map$CanonicalID, met_map$CanonicalID)
common_ids <- common_ids[!is.na(common_ids)]

cat("Shared canonical IDs:", length(common_ids), "\n")
print(common_ids)

if (length(common_ids) < 5) {
  stop("Too few shared samples found after canonical ID matching.")
}

# reorder matrices
genus_keep <- genus_map %>%
  filter(CanonicalID %in% common_ids) %>%
  arrange(match(CanonicalID, common_ids))

met_keep <- met_map %>%
  filter(CanonicalID %in% common_ids) %>%
  arrange(match(CanonicalID, common_ids))

genus_clr_aligned <- genus_clr[genus_keep$SampleID, , drop = FALSE]
met_scaled_aligned <- met_scaled[met_keep$SampleID, , drop = FALSE]

rownames(genus_clr_aligned) <- genus_keep$CanonicalID
rownames(met_scaled_aligned) <- met_keep$CanonicalID

# final metadata
meta_diablo <- genus_keep %>%
  dplyr::select(
    SampleID_16S = SampleID,
    TreatmentGroup,
    Time_Point,
    Mouse_Number,
    CanonicalID
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    met_keep %>%
      dplyr::select(
        CanonicalID,
        SampleID_Metabolomics = SampleID
      ),
    by = "CanonicalID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TreatmentGroup = factor(TreatmentGroup, levels = treatment_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(CanonicalID, common_ids))

stopifnot(identical(meta_diablo$CanonicalID, rownames(genus_clr_aligned)))
stopifnot(identical(meta_diablo$CanonicalID, rownames(met_scaled_aligned)))

genus_clr  <- genus_clr_aligned
met_scaled <- met_scaled_aligned

write.csv(meta_diablo, file.path(out_dir, "DIABLO_metadata_used.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Final aligned sample counts by treatment:\n")
print(table(meta_diablo$TreatmentGroup))

# ============================================================
# 5. build DIABLO input blocks
# ============================================================
X <- list(
  microbiome = genus_clr,
  metabolome = met_scaled
)

Y <- meta_diablo$TreatmentGroup
names(Y) <- meta_diablo$CanonicalID

design <- matrix(c(
  0,   0.1,
  0.1, 0
), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
colnames(design) <- rownames(design) <- names(X)

print(design)

# cap keepX at available features
test_keepX_microbe_use <- test_keepX_microbe[test_keepX_microbe <= ncol(X$microbiome)]
test_keepX_metab_use   <- test_keepX_metab[test_keepX_metab <= ncol(X$metabolome)]

if (length(test_keepX_microbe_use) == 0) test_keepX_microbe_use <- min(5, ncol(X$microbiome))
if (length(test_keepX_metab_use) == 0)   test_keepX_metab_use   <- min(5, ncol(X$metabolome))

init_keep_microbe <- min(20, ncol(X$microbiome))
init_keep_metab   <- min(20, ncol(X$metabolome))

# ============================================================
# 6. quick initial model
# ============================================================
diablo_init <- block.splsda(
  X = X,
  Y = Y,
  ncomp = ncomp_test,
  keepX = list(
    microbiome = rep(init_keep_microbe, ncomp_test),
    metabolome = rep(init_keep_metab, ncomp_test)
  ),
  design = design
)

saveRDS(diablo_init, file.path(out_dir, "diablo_initial_model.rds"))

# ============================================================
# 7. tune keepX
# ============================================================
tune_diablo <- tune.block.splsda(
  X = X,
  Y = Y,
  ncomp = ncomp_test,
  test.keepX = list(
    microbiome = test_keepX_microbe_use,
    metabolome = test_keepX_metab_use
  ),
  design = design,
  validation = "Mfold",
  folds = 5,
  nrepeat = 20,
  dist = "centroids.dist",
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

saveRDS(tune_diablo, file.path(out_dir, "diablo_tuning_results.rds"))

keepX_opt <- tune_diablo$choice.keepX
print(keepX_opt)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    block = rep(names(keepX_opt), each = length(keepX_opt[[1]])),
    component = rep(seq_along(keepX_opt[[1]]), times = length(keepX_opt)),
    keepX = unlist(keepX_opt)
  ),
  file.path(out_dir, "diablo_optimal_keepX.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# 8. fit tuned final model
# ============================================================
diablo_final <- block.splsda(
  X = X,
  Y = Y,
  ncomp = ncomp_test,
  keepX = keepX_opt,
  design = design
)

saveRDS(diablo_final, file.path(out_dir, "diablo_final_model.rds"))

# ============================================================
# 9. performance assessment
# ============================================================
perf_diablo <- perf(
  diablo_final,
  validation = "Mfold",
  folds = 5,
  nrepeat = 20,
  dist = "centroids.dist",
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

saveRDS(perf_diablo, file.path(out_dir, "diablo_performance.rds"))

# ============================================================
# 10. selected features export
# ============================================================
extract_selected_vars <- function(model, block, comp) {
  sv <- selectVar(model, block = block, comp = comp)

  feats <- NULL
  vals  <- NULL

  if (!is.null(sv$name)) {
    feats <- sv$name
    if (is.list(feats)) feats <- feats[[comp]]
  }

  if (!is.null(sv$value)) {
    vals <- sv$value
    if (is.list(vals)) {
      vals <- vals[[comp]]
    } else if (is.matrix(vals) || is.data.frame(vals)) {
      vals_df <- as.data.frame(vals, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      if (nrow(vals_df) > 0) {
        if (is.null(feats) || length(feats) == 0) {
          feats <- rownames(vals_df)
        }
        vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals_df[[1]]))
      } else {
        vals <- numeric(0)
      }
    } else {
      vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))
    }
  }

  if (is.null(feats) || length(feats) == 0) feats <- character(0)
  if (is.null(vals) || length(vals) == 0) vals <- numeric(0)

  n <- min(length(feats), length(vals))

  if (n == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      Feature = character(0),
      Loading = numeric(0),
      block = character(0),
      component = integer(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  data.frame(
    Feature = as.character(feats[seq_len(n)]),
    Loading = as.numeric(vals[seq_len(n)]),
    block = rep(block, n),
    component = rep(comp, n),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

sel_microbe <- extract_selected_vars(diablo_final, block = "microbiome", comp = 1)
sel_metab   <- extract_selected_vars(diablo_final, block = "metabolome", comp = 1)

write.csv(sel_microbe, file.path(out_dir, "selected_microbiome_comp1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  sel_metab_c2   <- extract_selected_vars(diablo_final, block = "metabolome", comp = 2)

  write.csv(sel_microbe_c2, file.path(out_dir, "selected_microbiome_comp2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(sel_metab_c2,   file.path(out_dir, "selected_metabolome_comp2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("Selected features exported.\n")
cat("Comp1 microbiome:", nrow(sel_microbe), "features\n")
```

```{r}
extract_selected_vars <- function(model, block, comp = 1) {
  sv <- selectVar(model, block = block, comp = comp)

  # block-specific nested result
  if (is.null(sv[[block]])) {
    return(data.frame(
      Feature = character(0),
      Loading = numeric(0),
      block = character(0),
      component = integer(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  block_res <- sv[[block]]

  feats <- block_res$name
  vals  <- block_res$value

  # feature names
  if (is.null(feats)) {
    feats <- character(0)
  } else {
    feats <- as.character(feats)
  }

  # loadings
  if (is.null(vals)) {
    loadings <- rep(NA_real_, length(feats))
  } else if (is.data.frame(vals) || is.matrix(vals)) {
    vals_df <- as.data.frame(vals, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    if (nrow(vals_df) == 0) {
      loadings <- numeric(0)
    } else {
      num_cols <- which(vapply(vals_df, is.numeric, logical(1)))
      if (length(num_cols) > 0) {
        loadings <- as.numeric(vals_df[[num_cols[1]]])
      } else {
        loadings <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(vals_df))
      }

      # if names missing, try rownames of value table
      if (length(feats) == 0 && !is.null(rownames(vals_df))) {
        feats <- rownames(vals_df)
      }
    }
  } else if (is.numeric(vals)) {
    loadings <- as.numeric(vals)
    if (length(feats) == 0 && !is.null(names(vals))) {
      feats <- names(vals)
    }
  } else {
    loadings <- rep(NA_real_, length(feats))
  }

  n_out <- min(length(feats), length(loadings))

  if (n_out == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      Feature = character(0),
      Loading = numeric(0),
      block = character(0),
      component = integer(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  data.frame(
    Feature = feats[seq_len(n_out)],
    Loading = loadings[seq_len(n_out)],
    block = block,
    component = comp,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

sel_microbe <- extract_selected_vars(diablo_final, block = "microbiome", comp = 1)
sel_metab   <- extract_selected_vars(diablo_final, block = "metabolome", comp = 1)

write.csv(sel_microbe, file.path(out_dir, "selected_microbiome_comp1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sel_metab,   file.path(out_dir, "selected_metabolome_comp1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

if (ncomp_test >= 2) {
  sel_microbe_c2 <- extract_selected_vars(diablo_final, block = "microbiome", comp = 2)
  sel_metab_c2   <- extract_selected_vars(diablo_final, block = "metabolome", comp = 2)

  write.csv(sel_microbe_c2, file.path(out_dir, "selected_microbiome_comp2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(sel_metab_c2,   file.path(out_dir, "selected_metabolome_comp2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("Selected features exported.\n")
cat("Comp1 microbiome:", nrow(sel_microbe), "features\n")
cat("Comp1 metabolome:", nrow(sel_metab), "features\n")
print(head(sel_microbe))
```

```{r}
cat("Matched microbiome features:", length(microbe_feats), "\n")
print(microbe_feats)

cat("Matched metabolite features:", length(metab_feats), "\n")
print(metab_feats)

if (length(microbe_feats) == 0) stop("No microbiome features matched genus_clr.")
if (length(metab_feats) == 0) stop("No metabolite features matched met_scaled.")

microbe_df <- as.data.frame(genus_clr[, microbe_feats, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("CanonicalID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -CanonicalID,
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_diablo, by = "CanonicalID") %>%
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = microbe_levels),
    TreatmentGroup = factor(TreatmentGroup, levels = treatment_levels)
  )

metab_df <- as.data.frame(met_scaled[, metab_feats, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("CanonicalID") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -CanonicalID,
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_diablo, by = "CanonicalID") %>%
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = metab_levels),
    TreatmentGroup = factor(TreatmentGroup, levels = treatment_levels)
  )

microbe_sum <- summarize_mean_sem(microbe_df) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = microbe_levels),
    TreatmentGroup = factor(TreatmentGroup, levels = treatment_levels)
  )

metab_sum <- summarize_mean_sem(metab_df) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = metab_levels),
    TreatmentGroup = factor(TreatmentGroup, levels = treatment_levels)
  )

write.csv(microbe_sum, file.path(out_dir, "DIABLO_barplot_summary_microbiome_comp1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(metab_sum,   file.path(out_dir, "DIABLO_barplot_summary_metabolome_comp1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# 17. plot selected microbiome features as dodged bars
# ============================================================
p_microbe <- ggplot(microbe_sum, aes(x = Feature, y = mean, fill = TreatmentGroup)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.72,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = drug_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Top DIABLO selected genera, component 1",
    x = NULL,
    y = "CLR abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# ============================================================
# 18. plot selected metabolite features as dodged bars
# ============================================================
p_metab <- ggplot(metab_sum, aes(x = Feature, y = mean, fill = TreatmentGroup)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.72,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = drug_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Top DIABLO selected metabolites, component 1",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Scaled intensity"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# combined bar plot figure
pdf(file.path(out_dir, "DIABLO_barplots_comp1.pdf"), width = 16, height = 12)
print(p_microbe / p_metab + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)))
dev.off()

# individual PDFs
pdf(file.path(out_dir, "DIABLO_barplot_microbiome_comp1.pdf"), width = 14, height = 6)
print(p_microbe)
dev.off()

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "DIABLO_barplot_metabolome_comp1.pdf"), width = 14, height = 6)
print(p_metab)
dev.off()

# ============================================================
# 19. optional faceted version with free y scales
# Useful if you want each metabolite/genus easier to inspect
# ============================================================
p_microbe_facet <- ggplot(microbe_sum, aes(x = TreatmentGroup, y = mean, fill = TreatmentGroup)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = drug_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Feature, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  labs(
    title = "Top DIABLO selected genera, component 1",
    x = NULL,
    y = "CLR abundance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_metab_facet <- ggplot(metab_sum, aes(x = TreatmentGroup, y = mean, fill = TreatmentGroup)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = drug_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Feature, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  labs(
    title = "Top DIABLO selected metabolites, component 1",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Scaled intensity"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "DIABLO_barplots_comp1_faceted.pdf"), width = 16, height = 12)
print(p_microbe_facet / p_metab_facet + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)))
dev.off()

cat("Done. Outputs written to:\n", out_dir, "\n")
```
